title: heliotropium houstonii
intro: Heliotropium houstonii, commonly known as Texas bugloss or Texas false heliotrope, is a flowering plant in the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits which include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Heliotropium houstonii include expectorant and bronchodilator properties, making it useful in relieving respiratory symptoms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
